name: Fate/Empire of Dirt
source:
The City of The Pyramids is heading for ruin,
and the power of the seven servants are needed in order to prevent it.
A magician makes a pact with the queen of the Shadow Kingdom, and challenges fate.
The Holy Grail War to destroy the holy grail has begun

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ296007.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
金字塔都市正走向毁灭，
唯有借助七骑从者的力量，才能阻止这一切。
一名魔术师与影之国女王缔结契约，向命运发起挑战。
为了摧毁圣杯而展开的圣杯战争，就此揭幕。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ296007.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
